about: What POST /api/check answers for print("hi") then print("woah") on the hello challenge. It passes on purpose (decision 5: no word minimum), and the message says only what was checked. backend/tests/test_honest_checks.py checks this is the real response; frontend/tests/feedback.spec.ts shows it on the page.

response.feedback: Python printed your two different messages in order. Read them back: does the first set the scene and the second surprise you? That part is your call.
